notes: Completes FR-18 as a minimal internal Pilot Operations capability, not a general administration platform.
DEC-11 applies: internal operators never impersonate Business owners; dedicated InternalOperator commands preserve actor, target, reason/provenance and audit.
Adds compact append-only generation diagnostics without raw provider/model payloads, prompts, stack traces or end-customer data.
Adds append-only internal support/intervention records and a bounded operator queue/detail read model.
Operator-assisted Profile correction uses source operator-assisted and clears OwnerConfirmed so owner authority is not fabricated.
Collaborative Opportunity preparation reuses the existing current evidence-aware generator; no free-form recommendation authoring is introduced.
Adds explicit terminal Opportunity withdrawal with required reason and optimistic concurrency; unsafe feedback alone never auto-withdraws content.
Owner Today, History, Goals and Profile navigation remains unchanged; operator routes live outside the persistent tab shell.
No Redis, queue service, warehouse, microservice, external helpdesk/CRM, attachment handling or paid infrastructure is introduced.
No production release, deployment, EAS build/submit/OTA, production enablement or production database mutation is authorised.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner granted standing approval for upcoming governed slices, including bounded design changes, implementation, fixes, certification and merge. VS-33 is limited to PRD FR-18 Pilot Operations.

VS-33 introduces no new external provider, customer-data collection requirement, attachment flow, release boundary or production enablement. The new privileged operator authority is governed by the existing InternalOperator policy plus DEC-11 and remains subject to Security/Product Intake/certification gates.
Product Owner explicitly authorised implementation and required use of PES/Loop and appropriate Superpowers skills.
